big = int(1e9 + 7)

def count_vertexes():
    global occ, nbr_vertexes, n
    occ[0] += 1
    nbr_vertexes[0] = 1
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        oc = [0] * (n // 2 + 1)
        limite = min(n - i, n // 2)
        for j in range(limite + 1):
            h = occ[j]
            if j + 1 <= limite:
                oc[j + 1] = (oc[j + 1] + h) % big
            if j - 1 >= 0:
                oc[j - 1] = (oc[j - 1] + h) % big
            oc[j] = (oc[j] + h) % big
        if limite + 1 <= n // 2:
            oc[limite] = (oc[limite] + occ[limite + 1]) % big
        total = 0
        for j in range(limite + 1):
            total += oc[j]
            total %= big
            occ[j] = oc[j]
        nbr_vertexes[i] = total
